name: @vala/desktop
author: Bkav
description: Vala Desktop — giữ phiên các hệ thống nguồn và mở cổng Vala như một ứng dụng

scripts.build: tsc -p . && node scripts/write-defaults.cjs && node scripts/release-notes.cjs && node scripts/copy-runtime.cjs && tailwindcss -i resources/ui.src.css -o dist/renderer/ui.css --minify && vite build -c admin/vite.config.ts && vite build -c vanban/vite.config.ts && vite build -c thongbao/vite.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/release-notes.cjs --strict && electron-builder --win -p never
scripts.package:zip: pnpm build && node scripts/release-notes.cjs --strict && electron-builder --win zip -p never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && node scripts/release-notes.cjs --strict && electron-builder --linux deb -p never
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . --noEmit && tsc -p admin && tsc -p vanban && tsc -p thongbao
